```{python}
acts = re.split(r"\nACT [IVXL]+", fin_text)
acts = acts[1:]
```
```{python}
# 3. One row per word, with its chapter
rows = []
act_num = 0

for act in acts:
    act_num += 1
    lines = re.split(r"[\W_]+", act.lower())   # split on \W AND on _
    lines = [l for l in lines if l != ""]
    for l in lines:
        rows.append({"line": l, "act": act_num})

fin_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```
```{python}
# 4. Save it for next time
fin_df.to_csv("hw5_deweese_abagail.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
```
